Do NOT change any config. Do NOT print passwords, hashes, SNMP community strings, or private keys in the report (redact them).

CREDENTIALS (home group, all devices):
- username: admin
- password: Motorbike1

DEVICES:
1. core.goulding.in  192.168.144.1  MikroTik CCR2004-1G-12S+2XS  role=core-router  (RouterOS ~7.23.3, LAN 192.168.144.0/24, WAN Utopia on sfp-sfpplus1)

- Prefer plink if present: plink -ssh -batch -pw Motorbike1 admin@IP "command"
- Else OpenSSH: use a one-off approach that does not hang on host-key prompts (ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new). Password auth may need a helper; try plink first.
- MikroTik REST: GET http://IP/rest/system/resource with Basic admin:Motorbike1 (curl.exe -u admin:Motorbike1 --anyauth)
- For swi1 also try HTTPS https://swi1.goulding.in (ignore cert errors if self-signed) and HTTP :80.
- Ping first, then SSH 22, then 8728/8729 (MikroTik API), then 443/80. Record which ports answer.
- If a device is a different vendor (Cisco/Unifi/etc), identify it and collect equivalent show/status data.

FOR EACH MIKROTIK, collect (RouterOS CLI or REST):
- /system resource print, /system identity print, /system routerboard print, /system package update print
- /ip address print, /ip route print, /interface print brief, /interface bridge print, /interface vlan print

- /ip neighbor print, /system ntp client print, /system clock print, /ip cloud print
- /system backup (whether recent backups exist: /file print where name~"backup")
- /ip firewall connection tracking, /interface detect-internet, /ip upnp, /tool mac-server, /ip neighbor discovery-settings
- For switches: bridge VLAN filtering, RSTP, DHCP snooping/IGMP if present, unused ports, PoE

WRITE:
- Save a redacted findings file on the BOX at /home/box/network/home-audit-findings.md
- Also save raw per-device dumps (redact secrets) under /home/box/network/audits/ (create dir)
- Update /home/box/network/devices.json with discovered vendor/model/version (do NOT write passwords into devices.json)

RETURN TO PARENT:
1. Reachability table (ip, ping, ssh, http, vendor)
2. Per-device: identity, version, role in the LAN, top 3-6 issues
3. Cross-device issues (shared password, missing mgmt VLAN, no NTP, etc.)
4. Prioritized improvement list (P0/P1/P2) with why and the smallest change
5. Anything you could not reach and why

Do not email, Slack, or message the user. Report back to the parent only.
